name: Murat Demir
bio:
Murat's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly, fueled by a childhood fascination with rally racing broadcast on late-night television in Istanbul. He initially pursued a degree in mechanical engineering, hoping to contribute to automotive design. However, after witnessing the strategic complexities of a Formula 1 race during a student trip to Italy, he shifted his focus to the management side of racing. He started his career as a data analyst for a small GT team, steadily climbing the ranks through hard work and a knack for identifying performance improvements.

As a sporting director, Murat emphasizes meticulous preparation and clear communication. He believes a well-informed team is an empowered team. He's known for his calm demeanor under pressure and his ability to make decisive calls based on data-driven insights. What sets Murat apart is his insistence on fostering a positive and supportive team environment, valuing the contributions of every member, from the mechanics to the drivers.

Joining JOTA Sport represents a significant opportunity for Murat to apply his experience on a bigger stage. He is eager to leverage his skills to help the team achieve its ambitious goals, and he is excited by the challenge of guiding the team to success in a highly competitive environment.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Murat has a serious but kind face, framed by his neat haircut and goatee.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten notes and diagrams.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against the table when deep in thought.
Insists on having a cup of strong Turkish coffee before every race.
